package.description: Find out how you use your time. Track your day and the programs you use. Automatically!

en-US.description: Find out how you use your time. Track your day and the programs you use. Automatically!
en-US.longDescription: TaskCanvas is a program which allows you track your computer usage throughout the day. It records the time that applications are used along with other information such as documents opened. Active usage, idle time and CPU use is also tracked.
en-US.name: TaskCanvas

zh-CN.description: 自动发现您的时间去向。全天候追踪您的活动及所用程序，一切自动完成！
zh-CN.longDescription: TaskCanvas 是一款能帮助您追踪全天电脑使用情况的程序。它会记录应用程序的使用时长，以及打开文档等其他相关信息。同时还会监测有效使用时间、闲置时长及 CPU 占用情况。
